verdict.rationale: Paystack documents an API that covers core Dashboard operations: collecting payments, managing transactions, transfers, and retrieving transaction and customer data. However, it only says these are 'other operations that you can also do from your Paystack Dashboard', not that every UI action has an API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or mapping of full API/Dashboard parity, API coverage of Dashboard features such as analytics and exports or settings and account administration, and independent or hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Paystack API lets you programmatically collect payments, manage transactions, and perform other operations that you can also do from your Paystack Dashboard.
